<!--
HOW TO RUN
This file runs ONE PLSC: rs-FC x RNI (cellular density) or rs-FC x RND
(neurite density). Pick which with the `block` parameter.
  Local (RStudio):  working directory = code/, then "Knit with Parameters..."
                    (or edit `block:` above) - uses the fake data automatically.
  Local (terminal): cd code
                    Rscript -e "rmarkdown::render('1b-plsc-clean.Rmd', params = list(block = 'rni'))"
                    Rscript -e "rmarkdown::render('1b-plsc-clean.Rmd', params = list(block = 'rnd'))"
  HPC:              sbatch hpc/1b-plsc.sbatch   (array job: runs rni and rnd in parallel)
All paths come from config.R. Outputs go to derivatives/plsc-<block>/.
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

## Import Libraries
```{r libraries}
graphics.off() # Clear all plots

library(plyr) # Data manipulation (load first to avoid conflicts)
library(dplyr) # Data manipulation
library(tidyverse) # Core tidyverse packages
library(ExPosition) # Multivariate data analysis
library(TExPosition) # Two-table ExPosition analysis (tepPLS)
library(PTCA4CATA) # perm4PLSC, Boot4PLSC, PlotScree, PrettyBarPlot2
library(data4PCCAR) # Helpers for PCA/PLS
library(corrplot) # Correlation plots
library(ggplot2) # Data visualization
library(readr) # Reading data files
library(kableExtra)

# Paths, iteration counts and variable lists all live in config.R
source(file.path(Sys.getenv("PLSC_CODE_DIR", "."), "config.R"))

# Which PLSC? params$block when knitting; PLSC_BLOCK env var otherwise
# (e.g. when the HPC falls back to running the purl'd R code).
block <- Sys.getenv("PLSC_BLOCK", unset = "")
if (!nzchar(block)) block <- if (exists("params")) params$block else "rni"
sb   <- struct_blocks[[block]]
dirs <- plsc_dirs(block)
out_dir <- dirs$plsc; fig_dir <- dirs$fig
cat("Running PLSC: rs-FC x", sb$label, "\nOutputs:", out_dir, "\n")
```

**Data:** output of `1a-extract-abcd.R` (Year 4) - the functional block (rs-FC, 78 Gordon network connections) and one microarchitecture block (RNI or RND, 68 Desikan cortical GM ROIs), row-aligned by `participant_id`, plus covariates. Both PLSCs use the same participants.

```{r load-data}
covar_df <- read_csv(file.path(deriv_dir, "covariate.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
rsfc_df  <- read_csv(file.path(deriv_dir, "clean-rsfc.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
smri_df  <- read_csv(file.path(deriv_dir, sprintf("clean-%s.csv", block)), show_col_types = FALSE)

stopifnot(identical(covar_df[[id_col]], rsfc_df[[id_col]]),
          identical(covar_df[[id_col]], smri_df[[id_col]]))
subj_ids <- covar_df[[id_col]]

cat(sprintf("Environment: %s | N = %d | rs-FC features = %d | %s features = %d | nIter = %d\n",
            PLSC_ENV, length(subj_ids), ncol(rsfc_df) - 1, toupper(block), ncol(smri_df) - 1, n_iter_perm))
```

## Performing residualization

Each block is regressed on the covariates in `config.R` (`resid_covars_rsfc`, `resid_covars_struct`); the residuals go into the PLSC. Head motion is not a covariate: participants above the mean-FD cutoffs in `config.R` were excluded in `1a`.

```{r resid-fn}
resid_block <- function(block_df, covs) {
  Y <- as.matrix(block_df[, setdiff(colnames(block_df), id_col)])
  terms <- ifelse(covs %in% c(categorical_covars, "site_id_l"), paste0("as.factor(", covs, ")"), covs)
  fml <- as.formula(paste("Y ~", paste(terms, collapse = " + ")))
  fit <- lm(fml, data = covar_df, na.action = na.exclude)
  res <- as.data.frame(residuals(fit))
  rownames(res) <- subj_ids
  list(fit = fit, resid = res, formula = fml)
}
```

###  MLRM for resting-state (function) data

```{r resid-rsfc}
Group1 <- resid_block(rsfc_df, resid_covars_rsfc)
print(Group1$formula)
Group1_residuals <- Group1$resid
```

### MLRM for microarchitecture (RNI / RND) data

```{r resid-smri}
Group2 <- resid_block(smri_df, resid_covars_struct)
print(Group2$formula)
Group2_residuals <- Group2$resid
```


## PLSC Analysis

### 1. Correlation plots

```{r corrplot}
# Input data for PLSC
data1 <- as.data.frame(Group1_residuals)   # function  (rs-FC)
data2 <- as.data.frame(Group2_residuals)   # structure (RNI or RND)

XY.cor.pearson <- cor(data2, data1)
write.csv(XY.cor.pearson, file.path(out_dir, sprintf("%s-x-rsfc_correlation.csv", block)))

# Symmetric colour limits that always cover the data (corrplot errors otherwise)
lim <- max(0.25, ceiling(max(abs(XY.cor.pearson)) * 20) / 20)

png(file.path(fig_dir, "correlation_plot.png"), width = 2400, height = 2000, res = 300)
corrplot(XY.cor.pearson,
  is.corr = FALSE,
  method = "color",
  col.lim = c(-lim, lim),
  tl.cex = 0.2, tl.col = "black",
  cl.pos = "b", cl.cex = 0.3,
  title = paste0("Pearson Correlation: ", toupper(block), " (rows) x rs-FC (cols)"),
  cex.main = 0.6,
  mar = c(0, 0, 1, 0),
  lwd = 0.1,
  col = colorRampPalette(c("darkred", "white", "midnightblue"))(6)
)
invisible(dev.off())
```


### 2. Package details

tepPLS(DATA1, DATA2, center1 = TRUE, scale1 = "SS1", center2 = TRUE, scale2 = "SS1", DESIGN = NULL, make_design_nominal = TRUE, graphs = TRUE, k = 0)

DATA1 : Data matrix 1 (X) - here rs-FC

DATA2 : Data matrix 2 (Y) - here RNI or RND

center1 / center2 : a boolean, vector, or string to center the data. See expo.scale for details.

scale1 / scale2 : a boolean, vector, or string to scale the data. See expo.scale for details.

DESIGN : a design matrix to indicate if rows belong to groups.

make_design_nominal : a boolean. If TRUE (default), DESIGN is a vector that indicates groups (and will be dummy-coded). If FALSE, DESIGN is a dummy-coded matrix.

graphs : a boolean. If TRUE (default), graphs and plots are provided (via tepGraphs). Keep FALSE on the HPC.

k : number of components to return.


```{r plsc}
data.design <- as.factor(covar_df$site_id_l)
data.design.vec <- as.matrix(data.design)
rownames(data.design.vec) <- subj_ids

pls.res <- tepPLS(
  data1,
  data2,
  center1 = TRUE, scale1 = "SS1",
  center2 = TRUE, scale2 = "SS1",
  DESIGN = data.design.vec,
  make_design_nominal = TRUE,
  graphs = FALSE
)

summary(pls.res)

# Inputs for 1b-plsc-chunks.R (chunked permutations / bootstraps)
saveRDS(list(data1 = data1, data2 = data2,
             Fi = pls.res$TExPosition.Data$fi, Fj = pls.res$TExPosition.Data$fj,
             nf_boot = min(nf2keep, length(pls.res$TExPosition.Data$eigs))),
        file.path(out_dir, "plsc_input.rds"))
chunk_dir   <- file.path(out_dir, "chunks")
read_chunks <- function(type) {
  f <- list.files(chunk_dir, paste0("^", type, "_.*\\.rds$"), full.names = TRUE)
  lapply(f, readRDS)
}
```

### 3. Number of Dimensions

The null hypothesis is that there is no correlation between the tables, so the permutation test gives a p-value for each eigenvalue.

```{r perm}
nL <- min(ncol(data1), ncol(data2))

perm_chunks <- read_chunks("perm")
if (length(perm_chunks)) {
  # Combine chunks from 1b-plsc-chunks.R: same formulas as perm4PLSC()
  fixedEig <- perm_chunks[[1]]$fixedEigenvalues
  stopifnot(all(vapply(perm_chunks, function(k) isTRUE(all.equal(k$fixedEigenvalues, fixedEig)), logical(1))))
  pe    <- do.call(rbind, lapply(perm_chunks, `[[`, "permEigenvalues"))
  nPerm <- nrow(pe)
  pOmni <- sum(rowSums(pe) > sum(fixedEig)) / nPerm; if (pOmni == 0) pOmni <- 1 / nPerm
  pEig  <- rowSums(t(pe) > fixedEig) / nPerm;        pEig[pEig == 0] <- 1 / nPerm
  resPerm4PLSC <- structure(list(fixedInertia = sum(fixedEig), fixedEigenvalues = fixedEig,
                                 pOmnibus = pOmni, pEigenvalues = pEig,
                                 permInertia = rowSums(pe), permEigenvalues = pe), class = "perm4PLSC")
  cat(sprintf("Permutation test: %d permutations combined from %d chunks (seeds %s)\n", nPerm,
              length(perm_chunks), paste(vapply(perm_chunks, `[[`, 1L, "seed"), collapse = ", ")))
  if (nPerm != n_iter_perm) warning("chunks hold ", nPerm, " permutations but PLSC_NITER = ", n_iter_perm)
} else {
resPerm4PLSC <- perm4PLSC(data1,
  data2,
  permType = "byColumns",
  nIter = n_iter_perm   # 10000 on the HPC, 100 locally (config.R)
)
}
print(resPerm4PLSC)
```

```{r scree}
eigs <- pls.res$TExPosition.Data$eigs
scree_df <- data.frame(
  Dimension = paste0("Dim", seq_along(eigs)),
  eigens = eigs,
  pEigens = resPerm4PLSC$pEigenvalues[seq_along(eigs)]
)
write.csv(scree_df, file.path(out_dir, "scree_values.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Omnibus p =", resPerm4PLSC$pOmnibus, "\n")

png(file.path(fig_dir, "PLSC_Scree_Plot.png"), width = 1200, height = 800, res = 100)
my.scree <- PlotScree(
  ev = eigs,
  p.ev = resPerm4PLSC$pEigenvalues,
  title = paste0("PLSC Scree Plot: rs-FC x ", toupper(block)),
  plotKaiser = TRUE,
  col.ns = "black",
  col.sig = "red"
)
invisible(dev.off())

kable(head(scree_df, 20), digits = 4) %>% kable_styling()
```


### 4. Loadings and bootstrap ratios

These are the loadings obtained after performing SVD on the cross-correlation matrix.

```{r loadings}
P.data1 <- pls.res$TExPosition.Data$pdq$p   # rs-FC loadings
Q.data2 <- pls.res$TExPosition.Data$pdq$q   # RNI / RND loadings
rsfc_loadings <- as.data.frame(P.data1)
smri_loadings <- as.data.frame(Q.data2)
```

```{r boot}
nf_boot <- min(nf2keep, length(eigs))
boot_chunks <- read_chunks("boot")
if (length(boot_chunks)) {
  # Combine chunks from 1b-plsc-chunks.R: same bootstrap-ratio formula as Boot4PLSC()
  # (mean over iterations / population SD over iterations)
  bind3 <- function(l) { a <- array(unlist(l), dim = c(dim(l[[1]])[1:2], sum(vapply(l, function(x) dim(x)[3], 1))))
                         dimnames(a)[1:2] <- dimnames(l[[1]])[1:2]; a }
  br_of <- function(cube) { m <- apply(cube, c(1, 2), mean)
                            s <- sqrt(apply((cube - array(m, dim(cube)))^2, c(1, 2), mean)); m / s }
  bi <- bind3(lapply(boot_chunks, `[[`, "brick.i")); bj <- bind3(lapply(boot_chunks, `[[`, "brick.j"))
  resBoot4PLSC <- list(bootstrapBrick.i = bi, bootRatios.i = br_of(bi),
                       bootstrapBrick.j = bj, bootRatios.j = br_of(bj))
  resBoot4PLSC$bootRatiosSignificant.i <- abs(resBoot4PLSC$bootRatios.i) > br_threshold
  resBoot4PLSC$bootRatiosSignificant.j <- abs(resBoot4PLSC$bootRatios.j) > br_threshold
  cat(sprintf("Bootstrap: %d resamples combined from %d chunks\n", dim(bi)[3], length(boot_chunks)))
  if (dim(bi)[3] != n_iter_boot) warning("chunks hold ", dim(bi)[3], " bootstraps but PLSC_NITER = ", n_iter_boot)
} else
resBoot4PLSC <- Boot4PLSC(data1,
  data2,
  nIter = n_iter_boot,
  Fi = pls.res$TExPosition.Data$fi,
  Fj = pls.res$TExPosition.Data$fj,
  nf2keep = nf_boot,
  critical.value = br_threshold,
  alphaLevel = 0.05
)

BR.I <- resBoot4PLSC$bootRatios.i   # rs-FC
BR.J <- resBoot4PLSC$bootRatios.j   # RNI / RND
colnames(BR.I) <- paste0("BR_Dim", seq_len(ncol(BR.I)))
colnames(BR.J) <- paste0("BR_Dim", seq_len(ncol(BR.J)))

rsfc_res <- cbind.data.frame(rsfc_loadings, BR.I)
smri_res <- cbind.data.frame(smri_loadings, BR.J)

write.csv(rsfc_res, file.path(out_dir, "rsfc_P-components.csv"), row.names = TRUE)
write.csv(smri_res, file.path(out_dir, sprintf("%s_Q-components.csv", block)), row.names = TRUE)

# Latent variable scores, one row per participant (used by the LMEs)
lx <- data.frame(participant_id = subj_ids, pls.res$TExPosition.Data$lx, check.names = FALSE)
ly <- data.frame(participant_id = subj_ids, pls.res$TExPosition.Data$ly, check.names = FALSE)
colnames(lx)[-1] <- paste0("lx_Dim", seq_len(ncol(lx) - 1))
colnames(ly)[-1] <- paste0("ly_Dim", seq_len(ncol(ly) - 1))
colnames(lx)[1] <- colnames(ly)[1] <- id_col
write.csv(lx, file.path(out_dir, "rsfc_lx-scores.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(ly, file.path(out_dir, sprintf("%s_ly-scores.csv", block)), row.names = FALSE)

# Keep the full R objects for later scripts / figures
saveRDS(list(block = block, pls = pls.res, perm = resPerm4PLSC, boot = resBoot4PLSC,
             ids = subj_ids, n_iter = n_iter_perm),
        file.path(out_dir, "plsc_results.rds"))
```

```{r sig-dims}
significant_dims <- which(resPerm4PLSC$pEigenvalues[seq_along(eigs)] < sig_alpha)
if (resPerm4PLSC$pOmnibus >= sig_alpha || length(significant_dims) == 0) {
  cat("Omnibus test not significant (p =", resPerm4PLSC$pOmnibus, ") - using dimension 1 by default\n")
  significant_dims <- integer(0)
} else {
  cat("Omnibus test p-value:", resPerm4PLSC$pOmnibus, "\n")
  cat("Significant dimensions (p <", sig_alpha, "):", significant_dims, "\n")
}
write.csv(data.frame(dimension = significant_dims,
                     p = resPerm4PLSC$pEigenvalues[significant_dims]),
          file.path(out_dir, "significant_dimensions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

### rs-FC bootstrap ratios as a network matrix

Same layout as Bottenhorn et al.: networks ordered along the sensorimotor-association axis (sensorimotor, attention/memory, triple network), lower triangle, diagonal = within-network. Only |BR| > threshold is coloured. If the real ABCD column names don't follow the `<net>_<net>` pattern, this chunk prints a message and is skipped.

```{r br-network-matrix, fig.width=6, fig.height=5}
# ABCD Gordon abbreviations, ordered along the S-A axis
sa_order <- c(vis = "VN", smh = "SHN", smm = "SMN", aud = "AN",
              cip = "CPN", ret = "RTN", doa = "DAN", cio = "CON", vea = "VAN",
              sal = "SN", frp = "FPN", def = "DN")   # ABCD 7.0 codes
plot_net_matrix <- function(br, dim) {
  pairs <- strsplit(sub("_mean$", "", lab_rsfc), "__", fixed = TRUE)   # 7.0: <a>__<b>_mean
  ok <- vapply(pairs, function(p) length(p) == 2 && all(p %in% names(sa_order)), logical(1))
  if (!all(ok)) stop("could not parse network names: ", paste(head(lab_rsfc[!ok], 3), collapse = ", "))
  a <- factor(sa_order[vapply(pairs, `[`, "", 1)], levels = sa_order)
  b <- factor(sa_order[vapply(pairs, `[`, "", 2)], levels = sa_order)
  # put every cell in the lower triangle
  row <- ifelse(as.integer(a) >= as.integer(b), as.character(a), as.character(b))
  col <- ifelse(as.integer(a) >= as.integer(b), as.character(b), as.character(a))
  df <- data.frame(row = factor(row, levels = rev(sa_order)), col = factor(col, levels = sa_order),
                   br = br[, dim])
  df$br_thr <- ifelse(abs(df$br) > br_threshold, df$br, NA)
  lim <- max(abs(df$br), na.rm = TRUE)
  ggplot(df, aes(col, row, fill = br_thr)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "grey85") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B", limits = c(-lim, lim),
                         na.value = "white", name = "BR") +
    coord_equal() + theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5), panel.grid = element_blank()) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = paste0(toupper(block), "-related rs-FC, Dim ", dim))
}
for (dim in dimensions_to_plot) {
  p <- tryCatch(plot_net_matrix(BR.I, dim), error = function(e) { message("Network matrix skipped: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
  if (is.null(p)) break
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0("rsfc_network_matrix_", block, "_Dim", dim, ".png")), p, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 200)
  print(p)
}
```

### Percent Variance
```{r pct-var}
pctVar_explained <- (eigs / sum(eigs)) * 100
variance_table <- data.frame(
  Component = paste0("Dim", seq_along(eigs)),
  Eigenvalue = round(eigs, 4),
  Percent_Variance = round(pctVar_explained, 2),
  Cumulative_Variance = round(cumsum(pctVar_explained), 2),
  p_perm = resPerm4PLSC$pEigenvalues[seq_along(eigs)]
)
write.csv(variance_table, file.path(out_dir, "percent_variance_explained.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
kable(head(variance_table, 10)) %>% kable_styling()
```
